content: Melvin-Koushki says the principle of complexity would seem to enjoin a teleological interpretation of history, such as our occult philosopher embraces: Ibn Turka holds the ancient wisdom, obscured in late antiquity, to have been recovered with the advent of Islam and the marriage between quranic doctrine and pre-Islamic philosophy from the first/eighth century onward, each generation of Muslim thinkers building on the last or renewing it as necessary by way of tajdīd.
